Copenhagen Fintech invites our partners to join our delegation to Singapore Fintech Festival 2025 – the world’s largest and most influential fintech event… This curated programme offers strategic insights, direct exposure to the Asian fintech landscape, and access to exclusive networking opportunities with regional and global fintech frontrunners . Why Singapore? Singapore is widely recognized as a global leader in fintech and innovation – ranked as the top fintech hub in Asia and among the most advanced globally (KPMG, 2023). Its progressive regulatory environment, led by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), actively
Its progressive regulatory environment, led by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), actively supports experimentation and responsible innovation across financial services.

As a strategic gateway to China and Southeast Asia – regions setting the global pace in digital payments, super apps, and platform-based finance – Singapore offers a unique vantage point into the future of financial services (World Economic Forum, 2024).
Days 1–3: Singapore Fintech Festival (SFF) Participate in the full three-day conference.
Copenhagen Fintech will provide curated agenda guidance focused on key themes for banks, pension funds, and insurance companies.
Private Side Events Join invite-only sessions exploring critical trends like super apps, AI adoption, and platform-based business models.
If you interested in joining, please reach out to corporate partner responsible; Marie-Louise Roth (mlr@copenhagenfintech.dk). ‍ Apply Here Mentors No items found.

Join our 5-day delegation to Bangalore, Mumbai & Gandhinagar. India is emerging as a global powerhouse in digital innovation, financial services, and scalable, inclusive solutions. Following the launch of our two reports this year— Green Fintech Denmark and Decoding India’s Fintech and Govtech Landscape —as well as our webinar on India’s fintech ecosystem, which you can access here , we are now organizing a dedicated India Delegation Trip . This initiative is designed for Danish companies and organizations looking to build meaningful partnerships, understand new market dynamics, and explore opportunities to scale globally through India’s unique value proposition. Over the course of five days, the delegation will visit Bangalore, Mumbai, and Gandhinagar , engaging with a diverse range of stakeholders, from financial services

Over the course of five days, the delegation will visit Bangalore, Mumbai, and Gandhinagar , engaging with a diverse range of stakeholders, from financial services organizations and fintech hubs to international firms and innovation centres.

Participants will immerse themselves in India’s innovation culture, take part in high-impact meetings, and gain hands-on exposure to frugal innovation, large-scale open digital platforms, and diverse customer-centric solutions.

The visit will offer: Insights into navigating India’s regulatory environment and market dynamics Inspiration from global companies successfully operating in India Connections with key ecosystem players such as banks, reserve institutions, and fintech accelerators Interested in Joining Our India Delegation?

If you’re a full-time founder building an ambitious fintech registered in Denmark — with a clear, validated problem–solution fit, early traction, and a solid roadmap — we’d love to receive your application. Criteria: We are looking for fintech or adjacent startups delivering clear value to financial institutions, based in Denmark or the Nordics that address a clear, validated customer problem and demonstrate early traction or strong market potential. Teams should show strong competencies, commitment, and a willingness to actively engage with mentors throughout the program.
